response.description:
Azure SRE
Agent now natively supports AWS and Google Cloud through built-in connectors,
available in public preview. Bring operational evidence together to investigate
applications and dependencies across Azure and your connected AWS or Google
Cloud environments. The connectors
use an Azure managed identity and identity federation with AWS IAM roles and Google Cloud Workload
Identity Federation.
There's no need to manage AWS access keys or Google Cloud service account keys,
build custom connectors, or host MCP servers. Use separate
connections for multiple AWS accounts, or one Google Cloud connection across
projects where the federated identity has permissions. Ask in natural language,
or automate investigations with incident response plans, scheduled tasks, and
workflows. Cloud IAM, SRE
Agent run modes, and tool approvals govern access and operations. Supported
activity can be audited in AWS CloudTrail and Google Cloud Audit Logs when
logging is configured. Learn more: AWS connector
guide   Google Cloud
connector guide
response.title: Public Preview: Native AWS and Google Cloud support in Azure SRE Agent
